Use these values: cos 90° = 0, sin 90° = 1, cos 30° = 0.87, sin 30° = 0.5.

## Task 1 · The magic tree (2 marks)

In a farming game, a tree grows when it is watered. The tree stands with its
root (the pivot) at C = (3, 0). The top of the tree is at T = (3, 2).

a) The tree grows by 1.5 (uniform scaling) about its root. Where is the top
now? Show the three steps. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=3 >}}

b) A leaf is at (5, 2). The tree is then mirrored with the factors (−1, 1)
about its root. Where is the leaf? (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

a) Write the rotation matrix R(90°). (1 mark)
